description: FakeLiterature 的检索快照：真实论文的元数据，摘要字段是我们自己写的一句话概括（不是原文摘要）。BERT 同时有 arXiv 预印本和 NAACL 正式版两条记录，用来练习去重。

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Freezes the pretrained weights and trains low-rank update matrices injected into each layer, matching full fine-tuning quality with far fewer trainable parameters.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.abstract: Pretrains a bidirectional Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and next-sentence prediction, then fine-tunes all parameters on downstream tasks.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.abstract: Published version of the BERT paper (same work as the arXiv preprint).

papers.title: Revisiting Few-sample BERT Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Studies why fine-tuning BERT on small datasets is unstable and proposes simple fixes such as bias-corrected optimization and re-initializing top layers.

papers.title: On the Stability of Fine-tuning BERT: Misconceptions, Explanations, and Strong Baselines
papers.abstract: Attributes fine-tuning instability on small datasets to optimization difficulties and recommends longer training with small learning rates as a strong baseline.

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP
papers.abstract: Introduces adapter modules: small bottleneck layers inserted into a frozen pretrained Transformer, trained per task.

papers.title: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
papers.abstract: Keeps the language model frozen and optimizes a small sequence of continuous task-specific vectors prepended to every layer.

papers.title: The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract: Learns soft prompt embeddings for a frozen model and shows the gap to full fine-tuning closes as model size grows.

papers.title: BitFit: Simple Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning for Transformer-based Masked Language-models
papers.abstract: Fine-tunes only the bias terms of a pretrained model and reports competitive results, especially with small and medium training sets.

papers.title: Towards a Unified View of Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning
papers.abstract: Frames adapters, prefix tuning and LoRA as modifications of hidden states and derives improved combined variants.

papers.title: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning
papers.abstract: Proposes (IA)^3, which rescales activations with learned vectors, and shows few-shot parameter-efficient fine-tuning beats in-context learning at lower cost.

papers.title: Efficient Few-Shot Learning Without Prompts
papers.abstract: SetFit: contrastively fine-tunes a sentence encoder on few labeled pairs, then trains a classification head; strong few-shot text classification without prompts.

papers.title: Making Pre-trained Language Models Better Few-shot Learners
papers.abstract: LM-BFF: prompt-based fine-tuning with automatically generated prompts and demonstrations for few-shot classification.

papers.title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter
papers.abstract: Uses knowledge distillation during pretraining to obtain a smaller BERT that keeps most of its language understanding ability.
